method: byte-count comparison of a two-step before workflow against one bitcode context --with-tests call, on a fixed node list at a pinned commit
before: bitcode context <dir> --nodes <node> --json (no --with-tests) stdout bytes, plus the full byte size of every distinct source file containing one of that node's (at most 3, per the --with-tests cap) covering tests -- the two-step flow of getting context, then opening each covering test's file to see it.
after: bitcode context <dir> --nodes <node> --json --with-tests stdout bytes, in one call.

threshold.metric: aggregate byte reduction across all nodes
